stress.insulator: SIL PAD 2000 0.254 mm strip behind BR1 (in series with the GBJ case)
stress.note: BR1 nodes sit within the line peak of the HOT return; case rated 2500 Vrms on its own (basic)

stress.insulator: GBJ2510 case alone (screw hole through the strip)
stress.note: at the M3 screw the strip is pierced; the case is basic by its datasheet rating, as M11 credits it

stress.insulator: 3M 5413 polyimide tape x 2 layers on the DF110S TCO (live case, TCO_L)
stress.note: TCO_L is line-side mains feeding PS2; no switching node. 7000 V per layer (3M TDS, ASTM D149)

stress.insulator: NTCALUG01A lug -> leads (SELV; sink at PE = SELV return through the PE link)
stress.note: no HOT stress by design; with the PE link open the SELV return floats and the stress stays at leakage level

stress.insulator: FR-4 pressure pad 1.6 mm (spring -> package front, supplementary)
stress.note: not a HOT barrier: the package front carries no HOT metal; credited for nothing
